name: sharing
title: Counters on a cache line
summary: Every worker increments a counter of its own, placed in the same word as the others', beside them in one cache line, or on a line of its own. The counts agree; the page compares the times side by side.

controls.name: layout
controls.label: Layout
controls.hint: compare runs the first three in turn; the others run one. Two lines apart is for processors that fetch lines in pairs.

results.name: elapsed
results.label: Elapsed
results.what: per layout, from the start barrier opening to the last worker finishing
